settings.question: How do I get my unique referral link?
settings.answer: Click Get your referral link on this page. Your personal link is ready to copy and share straight away.

settings.question: When will I receive my store credit?
settings.answer: Your $20 store credit is added once your friend's first order has been fulfilled. Use it on your next order of $75 or more.

settings.question: Are there any restrictions?
settings.answer: Your friend's 20% off applies to their first order of $50 or more. Your $20 store credit can be used on an order of $75 or more. Questions? Email info@shemakestransfers.com.
